note: No county or municipal zoning district polygon layer for Salem County NJ is queryable. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the web found only parcels, flood, land use and planning maps. The county planning board publishes static PDF maps (land use, base map, state plan), not zoning. Carneys Point and Penns Grove publish zoning as PDF maps; Pennsville's zoning is in a fasttrack portal lookup, not downloadable. Salem City's zoning is in ecode360 text with a 1976 map. No official zoning polygon service was found.
